critical_code_review_comments: services/dr_ai/agents.py schema declares additionalProperties=false but agents legitimately return extra keys (model, provider, generated_at, ai_available). Server-side to_dict merging adds those after Claude JSON parse, so validation is against Claude's raw output only — safe, but worth a code comment for future maintainers.

dr_v2.py synthesize endpoint silently swallows per-agent exceptions in asyncio.gather (return_exceptions=True + `continue`). Consider surfacing partial failures via an 'errors' field in the response so the UI can retry just the failed agent instead of blanket 'Regenerate all'.

Approval audit collection has no size cap or archival strategy. Append-only is correct for audit integrity, but a report_id whose supervisor spams accept/edit will grow the log array unbounded within a single document (MongoDB 16MB doc limit).

useDrV2Ai auto-synthesis fires on every (reportId, evidenceHash) change with only a 1.5s debounce — an aggressive typing session on the activity card fields will fire multiple cold syntheses back-to-back (each ~20-40s Claude latency, $$$). Consider making auto-synth opt-in behind an 'Auto-refresh AI' toggle or extending debounce to 5-10s once evidence stabilises.
Frontend savebar shows 'AI: OFF' briefly before /meta resolves (initial paint). Minor UX papercut — consider a 'loading provider…' placeholder to avoid false-negative signal.

Both share evidence with supervisor_name='J. Ortiz'/'M. Kim' and TEST- prefixed project number. No V1 daily_reports data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase C is production-ready per this run. Cold synth latency observed: ~40-60s for 3 parallel Claude calls; cached synth <500ms. Confidence with sparse evidence (single activity_card, no crew/equipment/weather) landed at 30-45% — expected AI behavior demonstrating no hallucination. For higher-confidence UI screenshots use pre-seeded drv2-b9f643a26802 (verified 85%+ in earlier main-agent runs). If preview /api/openapi.json becomes reachable, un-skip test_route_count_parity to verify 1447 route count.
